title: build_export_car(): fetch group CIDs from DB, write CAR
description: Implement build_export_car(pool, ipfs_store, group, limit) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String>. Query SELECT cid FROM articles WHERE group_name=? ORDER BY ingested_at_ms DESC LIMIT ? for article CIDs. Fetch each block via ipfs_store.get_raw(). Use the car_writer module to serialize as CARv1. The most-recent CID is the root. Skip CIDs whose blocks are unavailable (log warn, continue). Return complete CAR bytes.
